compatibilityReview.macOS: All 72 extracted Mach-O executable/library entries are arm64, require at most macOS 14.0, and resolve their non-system dylib names within the runtime. All flags in twelve Metal configurations occur in the corresponding native argument parser. Actual native parser execution is added to Apple Silicon CI.
compatibilityReview.attentionAndMemory: Retain matched q4_0 K/V, Flash Attention and existing unified-memory guard. QAT MTP remains restricted to CUDA by the production preset. No unqualified KVarN or mixed-cache tuning is introduced; upstream's Metal mixed-quantized-KV issue supports avoiding that combination.
compatibilityReview.nvidia: CUDA12 routing and the previous RTX20 SM75 artifact check remain unchanged. New inference tests used RTX4090; they are not RTX20 hardware qualification. The existing MTP fit calibration also exercised its reserve increase on CUDA13 without changing saved settings.
